description:
For ages, people have been asking me what supplements I take at 5AM, what I drink to get strong and how I battleproof my positivity, energy and longevity.

Well, over the years I concocted a morning elixir of sorts that has helped me incredibly.

Guess what: given all the requests, I’ve made it into what I believe to be the finest and most powerful morning beverage available in the world. Anywhere.

The great news for you is, in the spirit of helpfulness and dedication to you becoming the greatest version of your highest vision, I’m making the morning drink available (initially) to a small number of people. 

If you’d like to be among an extremely limited group invited to experience — and pre-order — what I believe is the world’s most powerful and refined morning beverage, DM me the words 👉🏾 5AM Fuel 👈🏾. 

Own your mornings and you’ll transform your life. You deserve to know how great your days can be.

Love + respect,
Robin
transcript: Hi, it's Robin Sharma. Well, a lot of people ask me about this configuration and this formulation of the morning beverage or morning cocktail that I use. I have actually taken two years to painstakingly calibrate and optimize the formulation of the morning drink that I personally use. And I've made it into a morning beverage that you are absolutely going to love. I've created 5AM Fuel, which I believe is the single best energy, health, and focused drink available in the world today. It comes in these stick packs. You just open it up, pour it into a glass of water, mix it up. You've got your 5AM Fuel to start your day at your best. Drink the beverage. You're going to be blown away by the results. And my encouragement to you is to make it a part of your morning so you stay at your absolute best. And I truly predict 5 a.m. fuel will dramatically help the way you live the rest of your life. Thanks a lot. Have a great day.
